mapper.select: SELECT m.menu_id, m.name, m.path, m.icon, m.type, m.sort, m.status, m.parent_id, m.created_at, m.updated_at FROM menus m ORDER BY CASE WHEN m.parent_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, m.parent_id, m.sort
SELECT menu_id, name, path, icon, type, sort, status, parent_id, created_at, updated_at FROM menus WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} ORDER BY sort
SELECT menu_id, name, path, icon, type, sort, status, parent_id, created_at, updated_at FROM menus WHERE parent_id IS NULL ORDER BY sort
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO menus (menu_id, name, path, icon, type, sort, status, parent_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{menuId}, #{name}, #{path}, #{icon}, #{type}, #{sort}, #{status}, #{parentId}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
